entries.name: INP-TXN-DATE
entries.longDescription: Stores the transaction processing date received from the input queue or parameter area, formatted as YYMMDD, used to control batch cutoff and schedule execution dates.

entries.name: START-TIME
entries.longDescription: Represents the target or scheduled trigger time (HHMMSS) at which automated background jobs or transaction tasks are scheduled to commence.

entries.name: QUEUE-AREA
entries.longDescription: The primary data structure holding inter-task queue control metadata, transaction payloads, and dispatch status information for automated processing.

entries.name: QUEUE-TXN-ID
entries.longDescription: Holds the 4-character CICS transaction identifier that is retrieved from or posted to the transient data / temporary storage queue for automated triggering.

entries.name: QUEUE-DELAY-TIME
entries.longDescription: Stores the configured delay interval duration used by task control to pause between queue polling cycles or scheduled task initiations.

entries.name: INP-START-FLAG
entries.longDescription: Control flag indicator representing whether automated scheduling is active, triggered, or disabled during the current processing cycle.

entries.name: INP-START-OBGO
entries.longDescription: Operational switch parameter governing whether outbound batch processing (OBGO) and related automated interface tasks should be initiated.

entries.name: COMM-BCNT
entries.longDescription: A communication record structure holding branch counter data, status indicators, and operational switches exchanged across automated branch processing routines.

entries.name: COMM-BCNT-STATUS
entries.longDescription: Reflects the processing status (such as active, ready, or closed) of branch counter operations during automated cycle execution.

entries.name: COMM-BCNT-CLOSE
entries.businessTerm: 分行櫃檯結帳關閉旗標
entries.longDescription: Flag indicating whether branch counter processing has completed and is closed for further automated transactions in the current cycle.

entries.name: CKOB-AREA
entries.longDescription: Data area structure used to coordinate outbound check and payment transaction verification before automatic dispatch or printing.

entries.name: STUS-AREA
entries.longDescription: Composite data structure containing operational status indicators, error tracking flags, and system lifecycle state information for automated tasks.

entries.name: OBGO-AREA
entries.longDescription: Buffer and structure dedicated to holding outbound transaction records and control information formatted for automated transmission.

entries.name: AUTO-PRINT
entries.longDescription: Data structure containing control headers, formatting fields, and print records used for generating automated system audit logs and reports.

entries.name: ABEND-MSG
entries.longDescription: Contains formatted diagnostic information, error codes, and descriptive messages logged when an unrecoverable exception or abend occurs.

entries.name: NPMICR-BILL-NO
entries.longDescription: Stores the check or negotiable instrument bill number parsed from the MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) data line for outbound validation and clearing reconciliation.

entries.name: CKOB-ACC
entries.businessTerm: 出埠支票客戶存戶帳號
entries.longDescription: Identifies the core customer deposit/checking account number associated with the outbound check clearing transaction record.

entries.name: NPMICR-ACC-ID-NO
entries.longDescription: The primary account identifier or customer ID encoded within the MICR data record, used for account matching and transaction routing.

entries.name: CKOB-BILL
entries.longDescription: Check number or bill reference number in the outbound working control area, used to locate and verify individual check transactions.

entries.name: TAT-NMICR-FILE
entries.shortDescription: MICR VSAM / CICS File Control Name
entries.longDescription: Defines the logical file name / DD name for the MICR dataset used in EXEC CICS file control operations (READ, STARTBR, READNEXT) to retrieve check clearing records.

entries.name: OUT-TEXT
entries.businessTerm: 輸出格式化訊息文字區
entries.longDescription: Working storage text area used to format output messages, status notifications, or terminal/log display lines during check processing.

entries.name: NPMICR-TXN-AMT
entries.longDescription: Monetary transaction amount read from the MICR clearing record, representing the face value of the check to be debited or cleared.

entries.name: NPMICR-OUT-FLAG
entries.businessTerm: MICR出埠交換清算狀態旗標
entries.longDescription: Processing status indicator in the MICR record indicating whether the check item has been processed, sent outbound, or is pending clearance.

entries.name: CKOB-TXN-AMT
entries.businessTerm: 支票出埠累計交易金額
entries.longDescription: Monetary amount stored in the check outbound work area, used for total calculation, balance validation, and downstream queue dispatching.

entries.name: NPMICR-KEY
entries.longDescription: Composite primary key for accessing the MICR dataset, consisting of account identification, bill number, and processing date fields.

entries.name: CKOB-OBQ1-CNT
entries.businessTerm: 第一出埠佇列處理筆數計數器
entries.longDescription: Accumulated count of check transactions successfully queued into the primary outbound processing queue (OBQ1) during the current run.

entries.name: WK-M019-ACC
entries.shortDescription: Work Account Number for M019 Inquiry
entries.longDescription: Temporary working account variable formatted for calling the M019 balance inquiry/check verification sub-routine or service program.

entries.name: TWA-TXN-TIME
entries.longDescription: Transaction time retrieved from CICS system services (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME) or TWA, recorded for audit trailing and batch sequencing.

entries.name: NPMICR-REC
entries.businessTerm: MICR票據紀錄完整資料結構
entries.longDescription: Full data layout for MICR check records retrieved from the database or file, containing check header, account info, amount, and clearing flags.

entries.name: CKOB-TASK-CNT
entries.businessTerm: 出埠作業任務執行計數器
entries.longDescription: Counter tracking the number of asynchronous tasks or transactions initiated during the outbound check processing cycle.
